articles.summary: Equity Bancshares, Inc. (NYSE:EQBK), (“Equity”), the Wichita-based holding company of Equity Bank, will release its third quarter financial results on Wednesday, October 14, 2026, with a press release issued after market close. Equity Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Brad Elliott, Equity Bank Chief Executive Officer Rick Sems and Chief Financial Officer Chris Navratil will hold a conference call and webcast to discuss earnings results on Thursday, October 15, 2026 at 10 a.m. eastern time or 9 a.m. central time. Those wishing to participate in the conference call should call the applicable number below and reference the Access Code below. United States (Toll-Free): +1 833-461-5787 Global Dial-In Numbers Access Code: 216 780 149 To eliminate wait times, conference call participants may pre-register using this registration link . After registering, a confirmation with access details will be sent via email. A replay of the call and webcast will be available two hours
articles.title: Equity Bancshares, Inc. Will Announce Third Quarter 2026 Results on October 14, 2026
